title: ceropegia columnaris
intro: Ceropegia columnaris, commonly known as the "Tiger's Jaw" or "String of Hearts," is a species of flowering plant in the milkweed family (Apocynaceae). This plant is known for its unique appearance, with long, heart-shaped leaves that grow on a trailing stem. The health benefits of Ceropegia columnaris include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high levels of flavonoids and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
